meta.title: The Archetype Is a Set
meta.subtitle: Adding a component never edits an entity — it hashes a different set, finds a different chunk, and copies the entity there

views.label: A sorted array of type indices
views.note: An archetype has no name of its own. It is a sorted array of component type indices, and that array is the entire identity.

views.label: There is no graph
views.note: No edge is ever stored. The new set is hashed whole and probed in an open-addressed table: hit reuses, miss creates.

views.label: What the entity actually pays
views.note: Two sorted arrays walked in step, one memory copy per surviving component, and a new index in a different allocation.

views.label: The bills that arrive later
views.note: A new archetype changes how many entities fit in a chunk, and drops the cached chunk list of every query that matches it.

boundaries.label: no edge is stored anywhere · the sorted set is the key

cards.title: The set, from the source
items: Types is an array sorted by type index, TypesCount long · Unity.Entities/Types/Archetype.cs:35
Adding a type builds a new sorted array on the stack · EntityComponentStoreCreateArchetype.cs:508
Then GetOrCreateArchetype hashes and probes it · EntityComponentStoreCreateArchetype.cs:14
The hash covers the whole array and is confirmed by MemCmp · ChunkListMap.cs:236, :312

cards.title: Why there is no edge cache
items: An archetype with N types has N ways to remove and thousands of ways to add
Storing that graph would cost far more than recomputing the key each time
The key is cheap: one hash over a few hundred bytes, one probe, one memcmp
So the graph lives in your head, not in memory — the table is the only structure

cards.title: What the copy actually is
items: Both type arrays are sorted, so Convert walks them as a two-pointer merge
Type in both: one MemCpy of count times stride · ChunkDataUtility.cs:625
Type only in the destination: MemClear, and new enableable bits set enabled · ChunkDataUtility.cs:635, :641
Type only in the source: dropped, and deallocated if it owned memory

cards.title: The two bills you did not ask for
items: Chunk capacity is recomputed for the new archetype · EntityComponentStore.cs:2481
It is capped at 128 entities per chunk whatever the strides allow · TypeManager.cs:705
Every archetype keeps back pointers to the queries that match it · Archetype.cs:39
So a changed chunk list drops those queries' caches · EntityComponentStore.cs:2682
